issues.description: Boss geometry and screw engagement are unspecified, so the self-tapping screws cannot be checked for strip-out, splitting, or sink on cosmetic faces.
issues.fix: Detail boss outer diameter, height, lead-in, screw engagement, and supporting ribs; validate with the selected screw supplier and molded samples.
issues.rule_citation: Boss wall ≤ 60% of nominal wall to reduce sink — Protolabs injection molding design guide

issues.description: Shell mating-face and split-line requirements have no datum scheme or tolerance stack covering tooling variation, assembly, and the applied leatherette.
issues.fix: Define assembly datums and inspection points; stack shell, finish, and fastener variation against the split-line requirement.
issues.rule_citation: Dimensional tolerances require defined datums and inspection methods — ISO 1101 geometric tolerancing

issues.description: Lens, image sensor, film engine, and light seals lack locating and sealing requirements. Their alignment and light-tightness cannot be verified in production.
issues.fix: Define locating features, optical-to-film alignment datums, seal compression limits, and end-of-line exposure and light-leak tests.
issues.rule_citation: Define functional datums and tolerances for assembly interfaces — ISO 1101 geometric tolerancing

issues.description: The rechargeable battery pack has no specified protection, retention, routing, or thermal separation from the flash assembly.
issues.fix: Specify a protected pack, mechanical retention, insulated wire routing, thermal clearances, and pack-level safety qualification.
issues.rule_citation: Safety requirements for portable lithium battery packs — IEC 62133-2

issues.description: Projected area along +Z: 13750 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 70.3 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
issues.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 90 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
issues.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Silhouette along +Z, raster 0.375 mm — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Measured wall 2.00-2.00 mm is within the PC/ABS 1.2-3.5 mm range; keep bosses/ribs ≤ 60% of nominal wall to avoid sink.
issues.fix: No change to nominal wall; core bosses and ribs to ≤ 60% of the wall.
issues.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines

issues.description: Leatherette material and attachment method are unspecified, leaving adhesion, edge lifting, and cosmetic durability uncontrolled.
issues.fix: Specify covering material, adhesive or lamination process, edge termination, and adhesion and wear acceptance tests.
issues.rule_citation: Specify material and finish requirements needed for production acceptance — ISO 20457 plastics molded-part tolerances
